verify.title: Please confirm that you are human
verify.intro: The provider shows a check for humans in the login sandbox. You do this check yourself: click in the picture where you would click on the page (usually the box). The platform only passes your click on; it solves nothing itself.
verify.picture: Picture {frame} of the login sandbox – click to click there
verify.clicked: Click sent – the next picture follows shortly.
verify.relay: Sign in myself in my own browser
reason.disabled: The automation is switched off on the device.
reason.no_sandbox: The device has no browser sandbox free right now.
reason.human_check: The check for humans was not passed, or you chose your own browser.
reason.consent_missing: The registration asks for a consent that was not given.
reason.account_missing: This address has no account yet, and the data to create one is missing.
reason.unknown_page: The provider showed an unknown page.
reason.mail_timeout: The login e-mail did not arrive in time.
